cards.title: Tomatosphere
cards.kidLine: Over three million students have taken part in Tomatosphere.
cards.fact: Plants can provide food, produce oxygen, and recycle carbon dioxide.

cards.title: Deep Space Food Challenge
cards.kidLine: Canada and NASA ran a contest for new ways to grow space food.
cards.fact: The challenge looked for food systems that need little water and energy.

cards.title: Growing food far from Earth
cards.kidLine: Far from Earth, supply trips are rare. Crews must grow food.
cards.fact: On the Moon or Mars, astronauts will need to be more self-sufficient.
